description.en: Ishikawa Prefecture is a prefecture of Japan located in the Chūbu region of Honshu island. Ishikawa Prefecture has a population of 1,096,721 and has a geographic area of 4,191 km2 .
description.zh-CN: 石川縣是日本的一個縣，為北陸三縣之一，縣廳所在地是金澤市。轄區相當於過去令制国中的加贺国与能登国。
description.zh-TW: 石川縣是日本的一個縣，為北陸三縣之一，縣廳所在地是金澤市。轄區相當於過去令制國中的加賀國與能登國。

photo.alt: "Yukitsuri" is a traditional technique for protecting the branches of the pine trees in the garden from heavy snow; trees are given support by bamboo poles and rope arranged a captivating conical layout.
